en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a formal military scene in front of a barracks building. Rows of uniformed soldiers wearing helmets stand in formation in a courtyard while officers with swords oversee them. A building with steps and an iron‑roofed porch is behind them, and additional barracks and horses are visible in the background. Red printed caption text appears at the bottom, and a red manuscript number "1566" is written in the top right corner.
